subject: Vendor onboarding: NimbleOps supplier expansion — DPA, data flow, and evidence needed
messages:
From: NimbleOps Procurement <procurement@nimbleops.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: New supplier onboarding — DPA and evidence request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick call this morning. NimbleOps is ready to add Redwood as a service partner for our payments analytics pipeline. As part of our onboarding we need: a signed DPA (we've attached our standard template), SOC 2 or equivalent evidence, a short data flow diagram showing where customer PII and telemetry will be processed, and confirmation of any cross-border transfers.

Can you confirm who on your side handles DPA redlines and provide the SOC 2 report for 2026? Since NimbleOps operates in APAC, we also need to confirm whether any data will leave APAC regions and which subprocessors (if any) would be involved.

Attachments: NimbleOps_DPA_v1.3.pdf
DocuSign link (for our signature): https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-12345

Regards,
Shweta Patel
Procurement Lead, NimbleOps
procurement@nimbleops.io

---

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: NimbleOps Procurement <procurement@nimbleops.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 18:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — DPA and evidence request

Hi Shweta — thanks for sending this over and for the call.

Short answers up front:
- DPA redlines: our Legal team (cc'd: Rishi) handles redlines; I will coordinate.
- SOC 2: we can share our 2026 SOC 2 Type II report (we typically provide a redacted copy to prospects under an NDA).
- Cross-border transfers: Redwood operates multi-region clusters; some model evaluation and telemetry routing may touch hosted nodes in us-west and eu-west unless you require APAC-only.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a published roster; I'll attach the current list and flag any APAC-hosted subprocessors.

Next steps: Rishi, can you take a look at the attached NimbleOps DPA and propose SCL (standard change list) exceptions if needed? Laura — can you review for any security/evidence gaps (dataflow diagram + required logs)? Shweta — is NimbleOps comfortable with a redacted SOC 2 or do you need full scope? Also please confirm the legal counterparty name and signing representative.

Attachments: Redwood_subprocessors_current.csv (referenced, will send in follow-up)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, NimbleOps Procurement <procurement@nimbleops.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — DPA and evidence request

Thanks — quick read. A couple of points:
- We'll request a few DPA edits (data retention caps, processor subprocessors appendix, and liability cap alignment). I'll propose tracked changes and return within 48 hours.
- For SOC 2: redacted is fine for initial review; full report can be shared under NDA.
- Need to confirm whether NimbleOps requires APAC-only processing (that will affect subprocessors and routing policy).

Shweta — can you confirm the expected data categories (PII, payment tokens, device telemetry) and whether NimbleOps will provide a pre-approved AUP for telemetry retention?

Rishi Malhotra
Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

---

From: NimbleOps Security <security@nimbleops.io>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbleops.io
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 13:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — DPA and evidence request

Hi Laura / Tessa,

For onboarding we need: a data flow diagram (high-level acceptable), network egress map (which provider regions), subprocessors list with roles and country locations, KMS/HSM usage notes (are keys customer-managed or Redwood-managed?), and retention/erasure SLAs for telemetry and logs.

Also: please provide any relevant documentation around encryption-in-transit and at-rest, and confirmation of logging/audit retention windows (we typically request 12 months for audit logs).

Regards,
NimbleOps Security Team
security@nimbleops.io

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: NimbleOps Security <security@nimbleops.io>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — DPA and evidence request

Thanks — I've started a short pack for NimbleOps. Actions for Redwood:
- I will attach (a) high-level data flow diagram and (b) an egress/region map.
- Kimberly (cc) — can you confirm whether any of our third-party telemetry processors (edge log aggregation or CDN analytics) have APAC egress that would involve data transfer outside the APAC region? If so, list names/countries and whether they are subprocessors under our DPA appendix.
- Rishi — once you have tracked changes on the DPA, we'll prepare the final package and provide a redacted SOC 2.

Attachments planned: dataflow_nimbleops_v1.svg (will attach in next email), redwood_egress_matrix.csv

Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: NimbleOps Security <security@nimbleops.io>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — DPA and evidence request

Laura / team — quick inventory:
- EdgeLogger (analytics CDN) — hosts edge POPs in ap-south-1 and ap-northeast-1; will see telemetry but we never store PII there. This is listed as a subprocessor in our roster.
- MetricsCache (inference KV caching provider) — hosted in us-west-2 / eu-west-1 only; no APAC presence.
- KMS: Redwood uses customer-managed keys for Dedicated customers, but for hosted customers we use Redwood-managed KMS (HSM-backed AES keys) located in us-west and eu-west. We can evaluate an APAC-only routing policy if NimbleOps requires.

I'll attach the current subprocessors CSV and a short exports map.

Attachments: subprocessors_current_oct2026.csv, egress_map_oct2026.pdf, SOC2_report_2026.pdf

Best,
Kimberly Park
Cloud Ops — Vendor Integrations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
